notes.title: Wesley Smith's Repair Game: Demo update at Couch Co-Op Fest!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Audune Games has been working hard behind the scenes to improve the gameplay and user experience for [i]Wesley Smith's Repair Game[/i]! For this Couch Co-Op Fest, we're excited to relase the 1.0.4 update for the demo.

Regarding gameplay, version 1.0.4 features a new score system where every action gives you points. The player with the highest score wins the match. For the full release we want to add modifiers for a game, so you can choose the condition to win a match yourself. Ideas we have in mind are most kills and most score in a specified time.

That's not all though! Also the user interface got a pretty big overhaul to make texts bigger and navigation the menus more intuitive. Thanks a lot for the feedback on that part of the game, feel free to let us know if you have more feedback.

Want to give your opinion on the new update of [i]Wesley Smith's Repair Game[/i]? Feel welcome to do so in the [url=https://discord.gg/2bbEpTkPDG]Audune Community[/url] on Discord! 

Have fun playing through all games at the Couch Co-Op fest and happy repairing!


[h2]Version 1.0.4 patch notes[/h2]

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Arcane Jungle map.
[*] New Jungle tileset.
[*] Match events score points, which are now used to determine the winner of a match.
[*] Frenzies drops multiply earned score and stack if a double, triple, or higher streak is collected.
[*] Portals now recolor based on if a human player is standing near them and what their destination is.
[*] interact button prompts now show in a match when a human player is standing near them.
[*] Possibility to invite a Steam friend using Remote Play Together in the player setup menu (not in the demo).
[*] Re-implemented quick match button in the main menu, now called practice match.
[/list]
[h3]Changed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated Unity version from 2022.3.47f1 to 2022.3.57f1.
[*] Changed layout of Carthographers Maze map.
[*] Tweaks to the behaviour of bot players.
[*] Big overhaul of the player HUD: items have fixed positions; items that can be crafted at shops now display if all ingredients are collected to craft them.
[*] Minor overhaul of other HUD: popups have a background; damage values show hearts.
[*] Big overhaul of the menus, primarily to be more intuitive and make text more readable.
[*] Minor performance tweaks in HUD code.
[*] Made tutorial texts more brief to fit better in the HUD.
[*] Improved sprites for entities and Freeze Ray and Taser items.
[*] Music in matches is now dependent on the theme instead of the map.
[*] Updated sound effects of several events.
[/list]
[h3]Removed[/h3]
[list]
[*]Removed Logistics Outpost map.
[/list]

notes.title: Wesley Smith's Repair Game: Demo available now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Audune Games is happy to announce that the demo for [i]Wesley Smith's Repair Game[/i] is available now! The demo will be a part of the upcoming Steam Next Fest starting October 14!

[previewyoutube=-3a6ZsoHoGc;full][/previewyoutube]

Help Wesley Smith to collect items, craft weapons and defeat his opponents in this frustratingly funny arcade game. Compete against the merciless bots or up to three friends in couch co-op mode to become the master blacksmith!

The demo of [i]Wesley Smith's Repair Game[/i] is free to play and contains the full gameplay loop with support for two players. Compared to the full release, the demo contains the following content:

[list][*]Local multiplayer support for 2 players instead of 4.
[*]4 out of 12 characters available: Wesley, Curlo, Serah, and Zomboid.
[*]2 out of 7 game modes available: Classic and Basic.
[*]4 out of 12 arenas available: First Labyrinth, Steel Spires, The Bazaar, and Splendid Palace.
[*]No generation of randomized arenas.[/list]

[h2]What to expect in the full version?[/h2]

While the gameplay of [i]Wesley Smith's Repair Game[/i] is essentially finished, there is still much to look forward to in the full game, that is set to release in 2025. Apart from fixing bugs and implementing your feedback on the demo, the following things would be added to the game in one way or another:

[list][*][b]Online multiplayer:[/b] While local multiplayer is extremely fun, it's also fun to play a match against your friends on the other side of the world! I'm looking into supporting [url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay/#together]Remote Play Together[/url] for the game, but implementing network code to provide a proper server-client multiplayer architecture is also something I want to research.
[*][b]In-game arena editor:[/b] For all creative folks among us, myself included, the full game will include an editor to create your own arenas, play them with your friends, and share them on the Steam Workshop!
[*][b]Original soundtrack:[/b] Don't get me wrong, Kevin MacLeod's music is great! However, as you might know I'm a composer and audio designer for games at heart, so I'm looking forward to craft an amazing soundtrack for the game and each arena![/list]

Apart from this amazing list, I'll also be looking into adding achievements to the game, as well as other minor improvements!

[h2]Discuss the demo on Discord![/h2]

Have you played the demo of [i]Wesley Smith's Repair Game[/i] and want to discuss it or give feedback? I'm happy to welcome you in the [url=https://discord.gg/2bbEpTkPDG]Audune Community[/url] on Discord! See you there!
